name: Miss Princess Miss Pri!
source: The protagonist aims to win the Miss Princess Contest where the only requirement is that you have to be a rich girl who is served by a butler. While cooperating with one of Kuryuuin Keiko's four butlers will she be able to conquer the Grand Prix and win the title?
translation: 主角的目标是赢得公主小姐大赛，唯一的要求是你必须是一个有管家服务的富家女。与红龙院惠子的四位管家之一合作，她能否征服大奖赛并夺得冠军呢？
